name: Goodreads
author: Safta Catalin Mihai
description: Browse your Goodreads shelves, search for books, and read community reviews from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Your shelves (read, currently-reading, to-read, …) in the bar, plus book search and community reviews.

schema.label: Goodreads user ID
schema.description: The number in your profile URL: goodreads.com/user/show/<ID>-your-name. Required.

schema.label: RSS key (optional)
schema.description: Only needed if your profile is private. Find it in the RSS link at the bottom of one of your shelf pages (the key= parameter).

schema.label: Shelf shown in the bar
schema.description: The shelf whose count the bar pill shows and that the panel opens on.

schema.label: Shelf refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar count is refreshed. Goodreads rate-limits scrapers, so keep this generous.

schema.label: Show cover art
schema.description: Covers are fetched from Goodreads' image CDN. Turn off for a text-only panel.
